Here, every trade idea has a reason, a defined risk and a follow-up, and its outcome is recorded so you can judge for yourself. If manual execution is hard for you, optional copy trading is available.
en.landing.read-the-analysis-and-the-condit: See the analysis and the conditions that create the setup.
en.landing.review-the-entry-stop-loss-and-i: Before acting, set the entry, the stop-loss and a position size that fits your capital.
en.landing.track-the-trade-as-the-scenario-: As the market moves, break-even moves, early exits or plan changes are announced.
en.landing.use-the-reported-outcome-whether: Use the final report, win or loss, to sharpen your next decisions.
en.landing.you-remain-in-control-of-your-ac: You always control your account, and your money stays in your own account. Copy trading carries risk like any trade.
en.landing.how-do-i-join-the-private-group: How do I join the private group?
en.landing.message-the-team-using-the-membe: Message the team using the membership guide button. They'll send the sign-up link, a Persian guide to opening and funding the account, and the steps to join the group.
en.landing.why-do-i-need-to-register-throug: Why do I need to register through the referral link?
en.landing.the-link-helps-the-team-identify: The link is how we identify your account; without it we can't confirm your membership or give you access to the private group.
en.landing.do-i-have-to-use-copy-trading: Do I have to use copy trading?
en.landing.no-signals-analysis-and-mentorsh: No. Signals, analysis and mentorship are the core service. Copy trading is for people without time to trade manually who prefer automated execution in their own account.
en.landing.what-does-a-trade-signal-include: What does a trade signal include?
en.landing.trade-setups-include-an-entry-st: An entry, a stop-loss and the reasoning, plus the condition that invalidates the analysis. After entry, updates and the final outcome, win or loss, are posted in the group.
en.landing.no-trading-involves-risk-and-los: No, and don't trust anyone who promises guaranteed profit. Forex trading is risky and losses are part of it. Past results don't guarantee the future; only trade with money you can afford to lose.
en.landing.fees-and-any-profit-sharing-term: Get the copy-trading terms, including any profit share or fee, in writing from the team before connecting your account, and check the broker's commissions and spreads. Don't switch it on until the terms are completely clear.
en.landing.the-team-will-provide-the-broker: The team recommends a broker that accepts Iranian users and supports USDT deposits and withdrawals, and sends you the sign-up link and full guide.
en.landing.do-i-need-trading-experience-to-: Can I start with no experience?
en.landing.no-prior-experience-is-required-: Yes. That's what mentorship and Q&A are for. We suggest starting on a demo account or with small capital, and not increasing size until you understand the risks.
en.landing.the-content-of-this-page-is-not: The content of this page is not investment advice. Trading financial markets carries the risk of losing capital.

en.landing.faq-is-membership-free: Does the private group cost anything?
en.landing.faq-is-membership-free-answer: No. There is no subscription fee. You only need to open an account through the designated broker link; once it's identified, you're added to the private group.
en.landing.faq-iran-deposit: Can I open an account from Iran? How do deposits and withdrawals work?
en.landing.faq-iran-deposit-answer: Yes. Iranian users can open an account with the designated broker. Deposits and withdrawals are in USDT, and the team explains each step. Before any transfer, double-check the network and the wallet address.
